name: order_lookup
description: Look up orders in the workshop-orders table. Returns all orders for a customer (product_id, purchased_date, status), or a single order when product_id is also provided.

customer_id.description: The customer ID, for example C-01.

product_id.description: Optional product ID, for example P-001. When provided, only the order for this product is returned.

name: user_lookup
description: Look up a customer profile in the workshop-customers table. Returns the customer's name and country_code (US, UK or IN), which determines which return policy applies.

customer_id.description: The customer ID, for example C-01.

name: product_lookup
description: Look up a product in the workshop-products table. Returns the product name, category (for example tablet or smart-speaker) and provider.

product_id.description: The product ID, for example P-003.
